exercises.instructions: Choose the correct alternative to complete each sentence.

questions.question: ________ I go out?
questions.explanation: 'May' is used to ask for permission politely. 'Might' is more formal and less common for permission. 'Can' is informal. 'May' ကို ယဉ်ကျေးစွာ ခွင့်ပြုချက်တောင်းရာမှာ သုံးပါ။

questions.question: ________ you be free from dangers!
questions.explanation: 'May' is used to express wishes or blessings. 'Might' shows less certainty. 'Must' is for obligation — not for wishes. 'May' ကို ဆုတောင်းချက်တွေမှာ သုံးပါ။

questions.question: Sue said that she ________ go to university the day before.
questions.explanation: In reported speech, 'may' changes to 'might'. 'Sue said' indicates reported speech. 'Must' is for obligation. 'Reported speech မှာ 'may' က 'might' ပြောင်းပါ။

questions.question: ________ I borrow a pen, please?
questions.explanation: 'May' is used to politely ask for permission. 'Might' is very formal. 'Must' is for obligation — not for asking permission. 'May' ကို ယဉ်ကျေးစွာ ခွင့်ပြုချက်တောင်းရာမှာ သုံးပါ။

questions.question: It ________ rain later on, but I don't think it will.
questions.explanation: 'Might' shows less possibility than 'may'. Since the speaker doesn't think it will rain, 'might' (lower possibility) is more appropriate. 'I don't think it will' ဆိုတာ ဖြစ်နိုင်ခြေနည်းတာကြောင့် 'might' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: It ________ rain later on. We'd better take an umbrella.
questions.explanation: 'May' shows higher possibility than 'might'. Since they are preparing for rain, 'may' (higher possibility) is more appropriate. 'We'd better take an umbrella' ဆိုတာ ဖြစ်နိုင်ခြေများတာကြောင့် 'may' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: She said she ________ take more pictures.
questions.explanation: In reported speech, 'may' changes to 'might'. 'She said' indicates reported speech. 'Must' is for obligation. 'Reported speech မှာ 'may' က 'might' ပြောင်းပါ။

questions.question: ________ I use your glue just for a moment?
questions.explanation: 'May' is used to politely ask for permission. 'Might' is very formal. 'Must' is for obligation — not for asking permission. 'May' ကို ယဉ်ကျေးစွာ ခွင့်ပြုချက်တောင်းရာမှာ သုံးပါ။

questions.question: You ________ come at eleven if you wish.
questions.explanation: 'May' is used to give permission. The speaker is allowing the person to come. 'Might' is for possibility. 'Must' is for obligation. 'May' ကို ခွင့်ပြုချက်ပေးရာမှာ သုံးပါ။

questions.question: Students ________ wear jeans.
questions.explanation: 'Mayn't' is used to deny permission formally. 'Mightn't' is not standard for prohibition. 'Mustn't' is for strong prohibition. For school dress codes, 'mayn't' is the formal choice. 'mayn't' ကို ခွင့်ပြုချက်ငြင်းဆိုရာမှာ သုံးပါ။

questions.question: He asked if he ________ borrow the car.
questions.explanation: In reported speech (indirect questions), 'may' changes to 'might'. 'He asked if' indicates reported speech. 'Must' is for obligation. 'Reported speech မှာ 'may' က 'might' ပြောင်းပါ။

questions.question: They wanted to know if they ________ come later.
questions.explanation: In reported speech, 'may' changes to 'might'. 'They wanted to know if' indicates reported speech. 'Must' is for obligation. 'Reported speech မှာ 'may' က 'might' ပြောင်းပါ။

questions.question: I am not sure but I think my camera ________ be broken.
questions.explanation: 'May' is used for possibility. The speaker is unsure, so 'may' (possibility) is appropriate. 'Might' shows less possibility. 'Must' is for obligation. 'May' ကို ဖြစ်နိုင်ခြေရှိတဲ့အခါ သုံးပါ။

questions.question: I don't know where your gloves are. They ________ be in the kitchen.
questions.explanation: 'May' is used for possibility. The speaker doesn't know, so 'may' (possibility) is appropriate. 'Might' shows less possibility. 'Must' is for obligation. 'May' ကို ဖြစ်နိုင်ခြေရှိတဲ့အခါ သုံးပါ။

questions.question: ________ the odds be ever in your favour!
questions.explanation: 'May' is used to express wishes or hopes in formal expressions. 'Might' shows less certainty. 'Must' is for obligation — not for wishes. 'May' ကို ဆုတောင်းချက်တွေမှာ သုံးပါ။

questions.question: ________ the Force be with you!
questions.explanation: 'May' is used to express wishes or blessings. 'Might' shows less certainty. 'Must' is for obligation — not for wishes. 'May' ကို ဆုတောင်းချက်တွေမှာ သုံးပါ။
